description: Replace security-scoped folder streaming with an Import-and-Copy Library in native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift. The user picks FILES (multi-select, so a .cue and its .bin tracks go in together), the app copies them into its own Documents directory under their original names, a SwiftUI Library lists the launchable entries found there, and tapping one hands its absolute path to the existing engine.launch. Because the content then lives inside our own sandbox, the entire security-scope machinery is deleted rather than merely bypassed. Swift only: no Rust, no build scripts, no workflow changes. project.yml and Info.plist already carry UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace, so no plist change is required.
steps: Rewrite the file header to record the architecture change: folder picks came back cancelled or never delivered on device, security-scoped streaming from outside the sandbox is too fragile to ship, and hand-moving folders in the Files app is not release-grade UX, so the host now imports and copies like Delta and Provenance.

Replace EngineHost.allowedTypes ([UTType.folder]) with a permissive pickerContentTypes = [UTType.item]. Comment the reason at length: iOS has no built-in UTType for .cue/.bin/.chd/.pbp, so UTType(filenameExtension:) returns nil for them and the picker greys those exact files out; that bug already cost two iterations. Acceptance is therefore enforced AFTER the pick by extension, and the comment must say so loudly enough that nobody tightens it back.

Add two static extension lists: importableExtensions = [bin, chd, cue, iso, pbp] (what may be copied in) and launchableExtensions = [chd, cue, iso, pbp] (what the Library offers as a launch target, so .bin tracks stay on disk but out of the list). Delete PS1.romExtensions, which is dead once the picker is permissive.

Rename presentFolderPicker() to presentImportPicker() and rebuild the picker: UIDocumentPickerViewController(forOpeningContentTypes: pickerContentTypes, asCopy: true), allowsMultipleSelection = true, shouldShowFileExtensions = true. Keep the pre-present breadcrumb naming the presenter and the dismissal-watch note, keep the topmost-view-controller resolution and its 'cannot present picker: no root view controller' line, keep activePicker retention, keep prepareForNewPicker(), and keep writing the 'picker is up' line INSIDE the present completion handler.

Rename FolderPickerDelegate to ImportPickerDelegate and EngineHost.folderPickerDelegate to importPickerDelegate, keeping the strong property on the host (the picker's delegate is WEAK, and a local delegate is deallocated before the callback fires). Keep both @objc pick callbacks, the @objc cancel callback and @objc presentationControllerDidDismiss with its outcomeDelivered suppression; update their HUD wording from folder to file.
Add a Sendable, Identifiable LibraryEntry model (id = absolute path, plus name, ext, byteCount and a formatted detail string) so List/ForEach identity is stable and never index-based.

Add documentsDirectory() returning FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first, and refreshLibrary() which enumerates it with contentsOfDirectory(at:includingPropertiesForKeys:options:), filters to launchableExtensions case-insensitively, sorts by name, publishes the result, and writes a distinct libraryStatus line for each of: no Documents directory, scan failure (with the real error), empty directory, files present but none launchable, and N games found.

Add importFiles(_ urls: [URL]) replacing launch(url:) as the pick destination. For each URL: reject a non-importable extension with a HUD line naming the file and its extension; wrap the read in a defensive startAccessing/stopAccessing pair whose result is NOT treated as a failure (asCopy: true already yields app-owned copies); compute the destination as Documents + the ORIGINAL lastPathComponent with no renaming ever, because a .cue names its tracks literally and a rename silently breaks the game; remove an existing item at the destination first (copyItem throws if it exists) and record it as replaced; copy with FileManager.copyItem(at:to:) inside a per-file do/catch so one failure cannot abort the batch. Then write a summary status of the form 'imported N of M: <names>' plus distinct clauses for replaced, skipped and failed files, and refresh the Library.

Rewrite launch to take a LibraryEntry: breadcrumb first, stop any running session, ensureCoreLoaded() with its belt-and-braces fallback line, confirm the file still exists on disk (a row deleted through the Files app must read as missing, not as a core rejection), then the single engine.launch(coreId:contentId:rom:filename:) call with rom: Data() and filename: entry.path. Comment that no security scope is needed because the path is inside our own sandbox.

Delete activeScopedURL, failAfterScope(_:_:), selectLaunchEntry(in:), the LaunchEntryOutcome enum and launchExtensionPriority, and reduce stopSession() to stopping the engine and clearing `running` so no half-wired scope lifecycle is left behind.

Add deleteEntries(at offsets: IndexSet) for swipe-to-delete: remove the file, report success or the real error on the HUD, note that any .bin tracks the entry named remain in Documents, and refresh the Library.

Build the SwiftUI LibraryView: a header row with an Import Games button, the libraryStatus line, real empty-state guidance ('No games yet. Tap Import Games...') that also mentions the Files-app drop fallback, and otherwise a List of Buttons over ForEach(host.library) with .onDelete. Show the filename plus extension and size. Keep it in ContinuumApp.swift so project.yml's explicit source list stays correct.

Rework PlayerView to stack the HUD panel and the LibraryView in the same overlay so diagnostics stay visible alongside the Library and nothing is hidden behind navigation. Keep MetalCanvasView, the telemetry wiring, the BIOS and GPU lines, the stats line and .preferredColorScheme(.dark). Update surfaceAttached to refresh the Library and report whether the Library is empty.
Sweep the file for em dashes and remove every one, in comments and strings alike.
acceptance_criteria: The picker is built with UIDocumentPickerViewController(forOpeningContentTypes: [UTType.item], asCopy: true) and allowsMultipleSelection = true; no allowedContentTypes entry is derived from UTType(filenameExtension:), and a comment explains that doing so greys .cue/.bin/.chd/.pbp out.
Accepted extensions are validated after the pick, case-insensitively, against cue/bin/chd/pbp/iso, and every rejected file produces a HUD line naming the file and its extension.

Each accepted file is copied into FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first with FileManager.copyItem(at:to:) under its ORIGINAL filename; there is no rename-on-collision anywhere; a colliding destination is removed first and reported as replaced; all files in a batch land in the same directory.
Each copy has its own do/catch, so a failure reports itself and the batch continues; a final summary reports imported count of total plus any replaced, skipped and failed files.

refreshLibrary() lists only cue/chd/pbp/iso, so .bin tracks never appear as launch targets, and it writes a distinct status line for the no-directory, scan-failure, empty, nothing-launchable and populated cases.

The Library is a SwiftUI view with an Import Games button, an empty state with real guidance, and rows identified by a stable Identifiable model keyed on absolute path rather than by array index; the list refreshes after an import.
Tapping a row calls exactly one engine.launch(coreId:contentId:rom:filename:) with rom: Data() and filename: the absolute Documents path; the Rust signature is unchanged.

activeScopedURL, failAfterScope, selectLaunchEntry, LaunchEntryOutcome and UTType.folder are gone from the file, stopSession() only stops the engine, and the only startAccessing/stopAccessing calls left are one defensive balanced pair inside the import loop whose false result is not treated as a failure.

The delegate is still owned by a strong property on the @MainActor EngineHost, all four callbacks are still explicitly @objc, the 'picker is up' line is still written inside the present completion handler, and the topmost-view-controller resolution is intact.
Every failure path writes a distinct, specific status string; no path aborts silently.
The HUD remains visible on screen alongside the Library.
No em dashes appear anywhere in the file. Only native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift and the .agents/tasks plan files are modified.
verification: swiftc -frontend -parse native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift -> exit 0, plus a by-eye review of the picker init, the four @objc selectors, present(_:animated:completion:), the FileManager calls, List/ForEach identity and every @MainActor hop (this sandbox has no iOS SDK, so parse is a spell-check only).
grep -n 'SecurityScopedResource' native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift -> exactly one start and one stop, both inside importFiles.

python3 yaml.safe_load on native/ios/project.yml and python3 plistlib.load on native/ios/Info.plist -> both still valid (neither file needed a change; both already carry UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace).
cargo test -> 74 passing, proving the Rust side is untouched.
git show --stat -> only native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift plus .agents/tasks/task-ios-import-library/** in the commit.
findings: Implemented in native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift on branch ps1-pcsx-rearmed and committed locally (not pushed). The file went from 858 to 1063 lines. Picker: presentImportPicker() builds UIDocumentPickerViewController(forOpeningContentTypes: [UTType.item], asCopy: true) with allowsMultipleSelection = true; the greyed-out UTType trap is documented in a long comment above pickerContentTypes. Import: importFiles(_:) validates each URL against importableExtensions [bin, chd, cue, iso, pbp], copies to Documents under the unchanged lastPathComponent, removes a colliding destination first and counts it as replaced, and wraps each copy in its own do/catch; the summary line is 'imported N of M: <names>' with extra clauses for replaced, skipped and failed. Library: LibraryEntry (Identifiable on the absolute path) plus refreshLibrary() filtering to launchableExtensions [chd, cue, iso, pbp], and a LibraryView with an Import Games button, empty-state guidance mentioning the Files-app drop fallback, size and extension detail, and swipe-to-delete through deleteEntries(at:). Launch: launch(entry:) does the breadcrumb, stopSession, ensureCoreLoaded, an exists-on-disk check, then the single engine.launch with rom: Data() and filename: entry.path. Removed: activeScopedURL, failAfterScope, selectLaunchEntry, LaunchEntryOutcome, launchExtensionPriority, PS1.romExtensions, UTType.folder, and the scope release in stopSession(). Preserved: the strong importPickerDelegate property, activePicker, all four @objc callbacks, outcomeDelivered suppression, the present-completion HUD line, topmostViewController(), the @MainActor hops that bind `let host = self.host` first, ensureCoreLoaded, the BIOS line, MetalCanvasView and its Coordinator, and .preferredColorScheme(.dark). VERIFICATION: swiftc -frontend -parse -> exit 0; the removal greps return no matches; engine.launch appears exactly once; SecurityScopedResource appears exactly twice (the one defensive balanced pair in importFiles, whose false result is deliberately not a failure); cargo test -> 74 passed, 0 failed; project.yml still valid YAML and Info.plist still a valid plist with both sharing keys True (neither needed editing). No em dashes remain in the file. The macOS type-check, .ipa build and on-device import/launch cannot run in this Linux sandbox and are left to the orchestrator's CI and device run.
